project: Selection, use and care of industrial rope access systems for accessing high work faces via vertically suspended ropes for painting works to a 6-storey occupied residential building with existing certified anchors
scope_of_works: Industrial rope access systems for accessing high work faces via vertically suspended ropes, where EWPs, scaffolds or building maintenance units are not reasonably practicable. Applies to industrial rope access systems only; excludes fall arrest systems. Access for painting works to 6-storey building with existing certified anchors.

paint preparation and containment on facade
